name: Commit Workflow
description: Triggers the commit skill workflow when the user manually triggers a commit. Reviews the diff, suggests log entries, confirms, then commits.

then.prompt: The user wants to commit. Invoke the commit skill from `.kiro/skills/commit/skill.md` and run the full workflow: check staged changes, review diff for loggable activity, suggest log entries, wait for confirmation, write confirmed entries, then commit.
